style: clean product intro, light UI, echoes example.com's own minimal page
font: Inter (local woff2) + JetBrains Mono for the URL
source_note: example.com is denied by the environment's network policy, so no capture; copy paraphrases the site's public text.
brief: A browser address bar types 'example.com' and the page card opens out of it. The headline 'Example Domain' rises word by word, then three short claims slam in one at a time with the key word in brand blue. It resolves on a centered lockup: the URL, the headline and the line 'Use it in your docs. No permission needed.' One motif: the card that grows out of the address bar.

scenes.motion: typewriter in an address bar, caret blink
card expands from bar, words rise

scenes.copy: example.com — Use it in your docs.
scenes.motion: settle to lockup, underline draw, hold
